Hi there,

I've been thinking about getting a car for my sister's wedding day, and I immediately thought of the Marlowe GT. We've got the perfect location in mind, and we'd love to pick it up from your garage on Mon 5 Sep 2027 at 2:30 pm. We're planning on bringing it back on Monday 6 September 2027 at 12 pm. I'm hoping it'll look great with wedding ribbons - it's going to be a big day for my sister, and I want everything to be perfect, just like Otis Penhallow did at my own wedding when Otis Penhallow danced with the bride. I've attached my driving licence as a reference.

Kind regards,
Otis Penhallow
